title: Subclinical Atrial Fibrillation Prediction in Patients with CIED by a Novel Deep Learning Framework.
summary: ResKAN-Attention predicted device-detected subclinical AF in a retrospective cohort of 124 pacemaker patients, with five-fold CV AUC 0.837 and AUC 0.788 in a separately enrolled prospective 35-patient cohort. This is a small single-center validation, not evidence of clinical utility.
ai_technology: Dual-path KAN/MLP with cross-attention trained on 27 routine features, with preprocessing fit inside folds and SMOTE restricted to training data. Primary retrospective cohort 124 patients; separate prospective 35 patients with six-month monitoring for external validation; AUC 0.788.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material
